method_review.area: Raw Git review and read-only preflights
method_review.judgment: The recipe preserves staged/working-tree/whole-branch selection, validated base/merge-base, dirty/untracked overlays and immutable review identity requirements. It disables external diff/textconv, FSMonitor, pager, color/relative narrowing and submodule omission for the relevant snapshot/preflight commands. Tests observe real content, no targeted helper invocation and unchanged index/worktree bytes.

The parenthesized C expression is correct; known reset bits, undefined bits, unverified documentation and conditional reset types are distinct. Whole-access read safety precedes masking; zero checkable bits are not-testable; undefined does not become fake zero or missing documentation.

Stream residuals/coalesced frames, nonzero-read EOF, legitimate empty datagrams, unrecoverable truncated datagram tails, partial-write offsets, length/overflow checks, bounded queues/backpressure and unchanged total deadlines are distinguished. Per-layer independent state/timeout semantics are restored.

Expected build identity, actual mapping and actual executed branch are not conflated. Complete path, process identity/starttime, deleted/changed/JIT/container cases and absent/permission-limited observations narrow the claim. The same executable selecting different real shared libraries demonstrates the gap.

The example checks the current operation identity and explicit readiness/cancellation under the same Condition lock, accepts legitimate result=0 and gives cancellation priority. Finite nonnegative waits use Condition.wait_for's monotonic remaining time. It preserves exact timing/debounce/throttle/backoff tests and does not raise timeouts to hide failures.

Global 11.3.8 identity is coherent and all eight changed Skill versions advance. The preregistration changes only candidate release to v11.3.8 and prepends v11.3.7 at the exact baseline SHA with model_runs=0; after reversing those two changes, parsed JSON equals the baseline.

checks: 0xA3 satisfies POR expected=3 under known_mask=0x0F; undefined high bits are not assigned a fabricated guarantee.
Software-reset 0xB0 is not judged with the POR-only contract.
Undefined FIFO reset with destructive reads remains not-testable for ordinary numeric readback; masking does not remove the side effect.
0x108 is genuinely unverified documentation and remains needs-fix, without fabricated zero or a publishable unknown definition.
Next steps preserve manual revision/errata, access width/endian provenance and authorization boundaries.
The supplied stream bytes yield abc then de, preserving the one-byte partial header and multiple frames.
Zero return is receive EOF only for a nonzero stream read request; residual EOF would be truncation.
The legitimate empty datagram and next are separate messages, not stream EOF.
ABCD with MSG_TRUNC is not a complete payload; absent subsequent data does not reverse truncation or enable tail reconstruction.
A partial stream write advances by the actual three bytes and never resends the prefix; datagrams are not split into fake continuation packets.
The two-byte header, 4096 payload maximum, length arithmetic and total buffering/backpressure limits are distinguished.
The total 30-second deadline is not refreshed by partial I/O; independent layer timeout/state machines and their parameter basis are explicit.
The outcome is inconclusive and no performance figures are fabricated.
Unchanged ELF and a new candidate disk hash do not prove which shared-library content was loaded.
The observed baseline mapping does not itself prove actual kernel/dispatch execution or exact mapped-content identity.
pass=12 does not establish target-kernel coverage, valid performance work or causal attribution.
The minimum next step is to request existing same-run identity/dispatch/KPI evidence; no unauthorized benchmark, process start or library replacement is proposed as already performed.

Transport execution did not cover the complete matrix: partial/no-progress writes, length overflow, backpressure, residual-frame EOF, cancellation or reconnect isolation in a real project implementation remain unmeasured.
C arithmetic tests do not execute SVD inheritance, real reset selection or safe MMIO. Mask-zero/undefined/unknown semantics were also checked through source and consumer reasoning.

Condition.wait_for does not establish hard bounds on lock acquisition or scheduling, or a complete application cancellation/cleanup protocol; producer same-lock discipline and real timing tests remain required.
Mapped path is not executed dispatch. Production kernel/ISA/precision/thread/model-path identity, performance gain and thermal causality remain unproven.
The one consumer session with three scenarios and a same-session reread has no blinded control, randomization or independent repeats. Model, token, latency and cost effects remain not-measured.
